值得閱讀的理由

  • 快速了解《Control: Resonance》的故事背景，以及它如何延續前作的兄妹故事。
  • 解析遊戲獨特的曼哈頓開放世界、重力變化與逐步解鎖的探索方式。
  • 呈現作者對遊戲優缺點的平衡評價，說明即使戰鬥不夠有趣，作品仍值得推薦的原因。
  • 介紹光線追蹤、DLSS 與合作顯示卡等畫面技術及硬體資訊。

摘要

作者為何喜愛《Control: Resonance》

作者 Rice 分享自己遊玩《Control: Resonance》後的感受：雖然作為動作冒險遊戲，戰鬥並不特別有趣，甚至可能是作品的弱點，但故事呈現、控制主題、視覺風格、世界結構與重力變化都十分出色，配樂也令人印象深刻。作者認為作品有望在 2026 年遊戲大獎獲得美術指導與音樂相關提名，並將在影片中探討劇情、戰鬥、角色成長、開放世界與推薦理由。

從兄妹故事延伸的超自然科幻世界

系列故事起源於一對兄妹童年時發現的幻燈機，投射出的影像成了通往異次元的入口，並引來聯邦控制局（FBC）介入。弟弟狄倫被帶去接受實驗與訓練，姐姐潔西則在前作中為了尋找失蹤的弟弟，進入不在任何地圖上的控制局總部「最古老之屋」，最後成為局長。她救出受嘶嘶聲（Hiss）控制的狄倫後，狄倫雖然脫離控制卻陷入昏迷，而潔西留在總部處理收容危機。

續作中，收容全面失效，異常物件逃逸，異次元空間彼此碰撞，整座曼哈頓陷入混亂。玩家改為操控狄倫，在開放世界中尋找失蹤的姐姐；相較前作以槍械為主的戰鬥，新作則將主要戰鬥方式轉向近身格鬥。

結構錯位的曼哈頓與重力探索

《Control: Resonance》的開放世界延續系列的類銀河戰士惡魔城設計：玩家能探索的區域相當廣闊，但曼哈頓受到結構扭曲影響，街道與不同維度的空間交錯，部分道路看似相連，實際上卻無法通行。隨著故事推進，狄倫會取得新的移動能力，探索也逐漸變得自由；到了中後期，穿梭於交疊的摩天大樓之間，宛如在城市中擺盪，而不同空間的重力差異更添科幻與奇幻感。

光線追蹤與硬體合作介紹

影片接著展示遊戲的路徑追蹤與光線追蹤效果。以銀行玻璃為例，開啟光線追蹤後，窗戶能呈現街道對面建築的細緻倒影，包括窗格、立面與明暗變化；玻璃、車輛、金屬及地面水窪等反光材質，也讓城市空間顯得更完整。作者並說明 DLSS 3.5 的光線重建如何利用 AI 重建光追畫面，改善細節不穩、閃爍與移動時的拖影，讓畫面在鏡頭轉動和戰鬥中仍保持清晰穩定。

影片也穿插介紹 ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070，以及 ASUS T1 聯名 RTX 5070 顯示卡。後者採銀黑配色與紅色點綴，背板印有隊員文字、簽名及 T1 標誌，並附有貼紙與收藏磁鐵；2.5 槽設計、散熱風扇、低負載停轉功能與強化背板，則兼顧機殼相容性、散熱與耐用度。作者表示，透過光線重建、DLSS 與影格生成，在 2K 解析度下可兼顧畫質與流暢度，並引導觀眾前往資訊欄了解產品。

即使戰鬥有缺憾，仍值得體驗

介紹完硬體後，作者表示將回到《Control: Ultimate Edition》與遊戲內容。整體而言，作者認為《Control: Resonance》並非靠戰鬥取勝，而是以超自然科幻敘事、獨特的空間設計、重力變化與出色視聽表現形成鮮明魅力，因此即使戰鬥未能完全滿足自己，仍想推薦給玩家。

================================================

Hi, I'm Rice, welcome to my channel. I've spent some time these past few. days playing Remedy's Control:. Resonance, and wow, I really love it! Whenever I encounter a game I love this. much, I always feel a bit apprehensive. Especially as an open-world. action-adventure game, the combat in. Control: Resonance isn't particularly. fun; it might even be the game's weak. point. However, various other aspects. —like the way the story is presented,. the concept of control, the visual. expression, the structured world, and. the gravity-shifting effects—are all. quite outstanding. Even the background. music gave me goosebumps. Overall, the. combination is quite stunning. The. first Control game was nominated for. Game of the Year, Best Game Direction,. Best Narrative, Best Art Direction,. Best Audio Design, and Best Performance. . For the 2026 TGA Game of the Year. awards, I personally think it has a. very strong chance of being nominated. for Art Direction and Music. At the. very least, I would be surprised if it. didn't get an Art Direction nomination. So, in today's video, I'll share what. kind of story Control: Resonance tells,. what the combat and character growth. systems are like, what kind of. open-world game it is, and why I still. want to recommend it to everyone even. though I don't find the combat fun. enough. The story of Control is a bit. difficult to explain and quite vast; it's a supernatural sci-fi tale with a. touch of New Weird aesthetics. The. story of Control originates from a. brother and sister who, as children,. found a slide projector. The images. projected by the slides turned into. portals to another dimension. After the. slide projector opened a portal, it. triggered a series of events that. caught the attention of the Federal. Bureau of Control (FBC). Subsequently,. the younger brother, Dylan, was taken. to the FBC for experimentation and. training, eventually becoming one of. the FBC's potential directors. The. protagonist of the first game is his. sister, Jessie. In order to find her. kidnapped brother, she tracks down the. Federal Bureau of Control, which. doesn't appear on any maps. She later. discovers this place is home to. mysterious ancient artifacts, and the. Bureau was built here to study them. Because the previous director died. under mysterious circumstances, the. Bureau decided to make Jessie, who came. looking for her brother, the next. director. After going through a massive. number of events, she finally finds her. brother, Dylan, who is under the. control of the Hiss. Jessie goes to. great lengths to purge the Hiss from. Dylan's body; although Dylan is no. longer under control, he falls into a. coma. Jess remained in the Oldest House. to manage containment breaches and. prevent disasters from escalating. However, in the sequel, containment. fails completely, allowing the breach. to ravage Manhattan. Anomalous objects. previously contained by the FBC have. escaped, and the threat is not singular. ; with spatial collisions between. dimensions and structural shifts, all. of Manhattan has descended into chaos. In the first game, you solved problems. within the FBC to find your brother. inside the labyrinthine Oldest House. and ended the containment breach. In. the sequel, you control your brother,. Dylan, searching for your missing. sister in an open-world Manhattan, with. the primary combat shifting from ranged. firearms to melee fighting. The. open-world level design in Control:. Resonance is quite different from every. other open-world game out there. The. map design in the Control series has. always had a strong Metroidvania vibe. The first game focused on exploration. within the massive, labyrinthine Oldest.

House, but Control: Resonance expands. this concept to Manhattan, creating a. much more open world. After the. prologue ends, the range of movement we. have across the map is actually quite. vast. However, because Manhattan has. been affected by structural shifts,. causing entities from different. dimensions to merge, the city becomes. quite surreal. You will often see. another road at the end of a street. that is perpendicular to yours, so the. areas we can reach and explore are. limited to a certain extent. As the. story progresses, we gradually acquire. new movement abilities, making. exploration on the map become much. freer. Running from point A to point B. feels restrictive at first, but by the. mid-to-late game, thanks to the. interweaving skyscrapers from different. dimensions, moving through the city. feels a bit like Spider-Man swinging. through the urban landscape. But. because these skyscrapers and. intersecting planes may have different. gravity, moving around creates an even. stronger sense of sci-fi and fantasy. With the ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070. co-branded graphics card, you can be. even more immersed in the ultimate. thrill of soaring through the city. This time, NVIDIA has added Path. Tracing support in Control: Resonance,. allowing both direct and indirect. lighting to be rendered in a more. consistent way. When toggling it on and. off, the most obvious difference can be. seen in the glass. Notice this entire. row of windows on the bank; without ray. tracing enabled, the glass still has. its material properties and you can see. some basic light and dark variations,. but the amount of detail within the. glass is much lower, and the. reflections of the opposite buildings. are almost invisible. Once we turn on. ray tracing, we notice the sheer amount. of detail in the glass increases. significantly. Most noticeably, you can. see buildings on the other side of the. street reflected directly in the bank's. windows—including the windows of. those opposite buildings, their facades. , and even the varying levels of. brightness and shadow, all reflected on. the glass. This feature is particularly. striking in*Control*. The game is set. in a densely built-up Manhattan, and as. we walk through the city, everything. around us—glass, cars, windows, metal. , and even puddles on the ground—is. made of materials that create. reflections. Sometimes, things not. directly in the camera's view can be. seen through reflections in nearby. glass, making the spatial sense of the. entire city feel much more complete. This time, it also supports DLSS 3.5. Ray Reconstruction, an AI network. trained on NVIDIA supercomputers that. replaces traditional hand-tuned. denoisers. Simply put, ray tracing is. meant to make light reflections and. shadows in games behave more like the. real world. However, if every single. pixel had to calculate all the light. rays, it would place an immense burden. on the graphics card. Therefore, the. data captured by ray tracing is. actually incomplete and requires. denoising and image reconstruction to. restore the final picture. With DLSS. 3.5, NVIDIA has updated to a. second-generation Transformer model,. which not only reconstructs ray-traced. images more clearly but also improves. overall visual stability. Since playing. a game isn't just looking at a static. screenshot, our characters are. constantly moving, the camera is always. turning, and a bunch of enemies on. screen are glowing, meaning light. sources are always changing. In the. past, you were more likely to see. flickering reflections, unstable. details, or motion blur trails behind. moving objects. Ray Reconstruction is.

designed to further improve these. issues. What they are striving for. isn't just image sharpening, but rather. maintaining a clean and stable. ray-traced image even while we are. actively playing and the camera is. constantly in motion. For this gaming. session, we are using the ASUS T1. GeForce RTX 4070 co-branded graphics. card, built specifically for. high-fidelity 2K gaming—this is a. collaboration between ASUS and the T1. esports team. The graphics card. features a silver and black color. scheme; the front has a black. triple-fan design paired with a red T1. logo, giving it a more understated look. . However, once you flip it over to the. back, the co-branded elements become. very prominent. You can all notice this. area right in the middle of the. backplate. Here, we have the words of. the five team members along with their. signatures, accompanied by a large T1. logo in the background. The black and. white sections, accented with red, make. the character and team logo really. stand out. You can also see "US" and " T1 fighting" on the side, so there are. quite a lot of details to see on this. card, with collaborative designs from. the fan centers to the backplate. If. you are a T1 supporter, this backplate. carries your faith and hope. The card. also comes with stickers and. collectible magnets; besides the. graphics card inside your PC, it’s. great for matching your desktop setup,. which is part of this collaboration for. fans who love collecting team. merchandise. It uses a 2.5-slot design,. striking a balance between powerful. performance and chassis compatibility,. making it easier to fit into various PC. builds and smaller cases. For cooling,. it is equipped with axial-tech fans,. using blade designs to increase airflow. and air pressure. 0dB technology allows. the fans to stop spinning when you're. not gaming, eliminating the noise they. generate. The back features a. reinforced backplate for structural. support and includes a 304 stainless. steel I/O bracket; beyond the. collaborative look, it ensures the. card's structure and durability. By. enabling Ray Reconstruction and DLSS. 4.5 Frame Generation, and pushing ray. tracing to the max in Performance. rendering mode, you can balance image. quality and smoothness at 2K resolution. . It handles current mainstream games. with ease, making it a top choice for. 2K gamers looking to upgrade. Those. interested in the ASUS T1 Gaming RTX. 5070 collaborative graphics card can. click the information below to learn. more. Thanks for your time; let's. return to Control: Ultimate Edition. I. really enjoy the gameplay of almost all. the main and side missions in Control. It’s not just about telling you to. kill a few monsters, collect materials. for an NPC, or usually even just taking. something from point A to point B. While these missions might involve some. combat, the primary way to solve them. leans more toward understanding the. internal logic of this supernatural. world. Even for tasks that involve. going from point A to point B, they are. mixed with different elements, perhaps. some seemingly crazy parkour or puzzles. that require a bit of brainpower and. patience. Since you obtain gravity. reversal and movement abilities quite. early, they can be utilized in most of. these puzzles. The 3D labyrinths you. navigate are true 3D mazes. Unlike. other games, it’s not necessarily. about noticing a specific visual detail. , but rather about logical reasoning. and understanding three-dimensional. space. The main and side quests I've. played have been quite fun, and even. some of the hidden bonus rooms are. pretty good. For example, we arrive at. a restaurant where we can see regular.

customer reservations, a coffee menu. listing various drink prices, some. weathered posters on the walls, and. limited-edition coffee promotions on. each table. For instance, table four is. for espresso and table two for caramel. latte; the complete clues are right. here for you to deduce. Nearby, you can. find a cash register where you can. enter a code, and once opened, you can. enter a hidden basement. There are many. little puzzle games like this; besides. collecting notes that flesh out the. world-building, you can also gain. upgrades or energy capacity. Another. one involves seeing character strings. like "journey,""window," and "thunder" in paintings. Inside the building, you. see a large painting accompanied by. three smaller ones, and you can press. buttons to switch lighting to align. them—I can't explain it clearly. because I truly don't get it; it’s. the only puzzle I accidentally solved. without understanding the logic. Even. the main and side quests follow this. concept; for example, one mission. guides us to a strange museum, where. there is a microwave that can soothe. anxious emotions and a coffee cup that. can rescue a practice session. We come. here to find the Sink speakers that. triggered mysterious events; these. speakers and subwoofers are scattered. across various areas. You have to put. some effort into finding them,. retrieving them, and then returning to. the auction house to place them in. designated spots, which keeps the. puzzles confined to one room or a few. small rooms, within a searchable range. So, at first, I just carried an item. around everywhere to see where it could. be placed, then just shoved it in—a. brute-force solution. I suspect they. tightened the interaction range and the. required aiming direction specifically. to prevent players from playing that. way. When I realized this, I. specifically opened the file to look at. it and found clear hints telling me how. to proceed: one must be placed on a. glass surface, one on a rock surface,. the third on a log surface, the fourth. on a blue surface, and finally, the. subwoofer must be in direct contact. with water, so I had to find the. corresponding locations one by one. Or. take the taxi puzzle, for example. You’re transported to another. dimension where you find a lost. civilian. If Dylan wants to save him,. you have to observe the environmental. changes to identify the one taxi that. looks different from the rest. At first. , I thought about brute-forcing it by. checking every car in order. If you get. it right, a green light shows; if you. get it wrong, it’s a red light. The. trick is to watch the lights and spot. which car is different from the others. The taxi puzzle has many different. stages spread across each map, and the. gameplay varies slightly each time. For. instance, some aren't about finding the. difference, but solving a puzzle, while. others require you to use a flashlight. to uncover the solution. There are many. logic puzzles like this; there isn't an. exact count, but there are easily a. dozen or twenty of them, big and small. There are cameras that pause time; if. you pass in front of them, you’ll be. frozen and then teleported away. The. way to solve this is to find another. path, sneak up from behind, and close. the lens cap. There are many puzzles. like this, so I won't list them all. The resonance control missions are. generally this type. Although most. include at least one combat encounter,. the core puzzle-solving elements are. quite satisfying. Overall, you might. feel some frustration when you can't. solve a puzzle. I was playing the media. preview version, so there were no. guides to check, and with the added. time pressure, it was even more.

frustrating. But as for feeling. repetitive, even the puzzles that share. the same theme are newly designed, so. it doesn't really feel like a chore. Two other aspects that are done very. well are the music and the art. The. 2019 version of Control was nominated. for Best Audio. They really captured. the feeling of sounds from another. dimension, and the ambient noise and. sense of space are excellent. However,. this isn't my area of expertise; I. don't know much about it, so I can't. say exactly why it's good—I just know. that it is. I especially want to. mention the music this time. When. certain background tracks kick in. during the story, the emotional impact. is similar to Death Stranding,. perfectly matching the mood where you. can feel Dylan's loneliness and sorrow. As for the art, I really love these. strange, fantastic urban landscapes. I. haven't seen designs like this in many. other games; it feels like something. very fresh to me. Plus, Control uses a. framework similar to the SCP Foundation. , where the world is full of objects. with supernatural powers and is being. tugged at by various forces, allowing. many absurd concepts to be presented. naturally within this worldview. The. eerie atmosphere is well-controlled; it’s unsettling and strange, but not. exactly scary. Between sci-fi and. grotesque, I feel it leans more toward. sci-fi, and the entrance of some bosses. provides a great sense of dread and. impact. I don’t know how to describe. it other than saying I really like it,. and I think it will have no problem. being nominated for Best Art Direction. this year. The combat and character. progression are a bit subtle; the. combat isn't bad, it just doesn't stay. fun for very long. At the start, we can. choose our basic attack from three. different styles: a slash that deals. high damage from behind, a fast,. high-crit flurry, or a wide-range. attack with knockback. As the story. progresses, our attack methods increase. ; in addition to basic attacks, we gain. a secondary attack on the right mouse. button, which also offers three choices. . Then, we get finishers to use after. basic attacks, where you can choose one. out of six different finishing moves. After defeating the boss of each map,. you gain related skills, such as. throwing stones at flying enemies from. a distance, summoning a mutant form to. throw for an explosion, or creating a. barrier to absorb damage; this is. another pick-three scenario. Every. subsequent skill is a pick-two,. allowing you to choose between two. different directions to customize your. own playstyle based on your combat. habits. Your primary skills, secondary. skills, and finishers all have upgrades. you can invest in. Each upgrade. consumes materials you’ve gathered. from monsters or exploration, as well. as some "Origin"—the currency used in. this world—which can also be. purchased from map vendors. A small. problem arises here: although we have. many combat styles to choose from,. talents cannot be switched freely once. chosen, and the cost of resources—. which can be bought from merchants—. creates conflict, making every talent. reset a psychological burden. Even when. fighting bosses, unless the battle is. particularly difficult, I really don't. want to change my talents just for one. or two skills. On another note, the. basic attack I chose at the beginning. was so strong that it was arguably the. best move from start to finish: three. quick light attacks followed by three. wide spins, which is not only. high-damage and wide-range, but also. shreds armor. Some of the skills on. hand aren't exactly bad, but take. throwing stones for example—unless. the enemy is already at a great.

distance, it consumes energy and deals. less damage than a wide swing. Some. skills have casting animations that eat. into your basic attack time, and since. their damage is far lower than basic. melee strikes, I rarely use them. By. exploring, completing quests, or. purchasing blueprints from shops, you. can craft equipment in the inner world,. and these items provide a variety of. different effects. Since I tend to play. more recklessly and prefer to trade. health for damage, I equip talismans. focused on health recovery, such as. increasing the chance to restore HP. after a perfect dodge, or gradually. regaining health while staying near. summoned objects. A big reason for this. is using the fungal override; this. skill has no casting animation, so you. can trigger it after your ultimate or. before a basic attack without. disrupting your normal DPS. Paired with. a talisman that heals, it has become a. staple for me. When basic attacks are. combined with the constant. energy-draining ignition, both damage. and armor penetration jump a level,. making it even harder for me to find a. chance to test other playstyles. The. game features another design called. mutation intensity; the more you. upgrade attack forms and finishers, the. higher your intensity becomes. Most. materials drop from specific monsters,. and each upgrade costs currency—or. even more if you lack the materials. There is a key material called a. Pyro-Body Fragment, which is the core. resource used to unlock other weapon. forms or core skills. So, even if you. don't intend to use other weapons, you. will still want to actively unlock them. , because the higher your mutation. intensity, the stronger you become. Some basic talents use basic materials,. and as long as you unlock one form, you. can jump several levels in your. finishers. These Pyro-Body Fragments. can also be purchased with money, and. the most basic way to earn currency or. materials is by defeating monsters,. actively exploring the map, or. completing temporary missions that. suddenly appear. There are quite a few. types—I haven't counted carefully,. but there are probably seven to ten—. yet most of these missions are. accompanied by combat or are primarily. combat-focused. For instance, "Glitch. Caves" requires finding items corrupted. by glitches, "Hold the Line" is about. helping guerrillas protect supplies,. and "Floating Purge" involves shooting. down floating glitches and clearing out. morphed ones; these and similar. missions use various reasons and. methods to invite you into battle. I. did try out some different things, but. since basic attacks with the left mouse. button are just too powerful, putting. my energy into Ignite was the most. optimal build I could think of. Compared to other combat styles, Ignite. is really fast. I didn't want to pay. the cost to respec talents, so I spent. my upgrades elsewhere, which made the. combat feel a bit tedious. The visual. presentation during boss fights is. genuinely great—very spectacular,. satisfying to play, and quite creative. But some fights are a bit more boring; maybe I just don't get how to play them. , but even against bosses, I mostly. just spam the left mouse button. I'll. mention this briefly: as you can tell. from my script, I’m using mouse and. keyboard this time. Because there are. frequent gravity shifts and the. movement mechanics feel more. significant than the combat, I find the. mouse much better for camera control. For me, playing with a controller,. whether for exploration or combat,. would be significantly harder. Again,. the combat isn't bad; it just doesn't. stay fun for long. Even my. counter-attacks and single-target.

damage don't look better than just. spamming the left mouse button,. especially later on when you unlock the. final talent for the living rift—. after upgrading it, you can just spin. infinitely until you decide to stop. Although I agree that the core of the. game is puzzle-solving, the frequency. and number of combat encounters are. quite high, which creates a grindy. feeling, and with the enemy swarms, it. can get a little annoying. There are. also some design choices that make me. —let me explain the situation first. —the talent tree is filled with a. large number of talents for specific. effects, such as turrets, summons,. thermal auras, pushes, or domination. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 快速了解《Control: Resonance》的故事背景，以及它如何延續前作的兄妹故事。
  • 解析遊戲獨特的曼哈頓開放世界、重力變化與逐步解鎖的探索方式。
  • 呈現作者對遊戲優缺點的平衡評價，說明即使戰鬥不夠有趣，作品仍值得推薦的原因。
  • 介紹光線追蹤、DLSS 與合作顯示卡等畫面技術及硬體資訊。

摘要

作者為何喜愛《Control: Resonance》

作者 Rice 分享自己遊玩《Control: Resonance》後的感受：雖然作為動作冒險遊戲，戰鬥並不特別有趣，甚至可能是作品的弱點，但故事呈現、控制主題、視覺風格、世界結構與重力變化都十分出色，配樂也令人印象深刻。作者認為作品有望在 2026 年遊戲大獎獲得美術指導與音樂相關提名，並將在影片中探討劇情、戰鬥、角色成長、開放世界與推薦理由。

從兄妹故事延伸的超自然科幻世界

系列故事起源於一對兄妹童年時發現的幻燈機，投射出的影像成了通往異次元的入口，並引來聯邦控制局（FBC）介入。弟弟狄倫被帶去接受實驗與訓練，姐姐潔西則在前作中為了尋找失蹤的弟弟，進入不在任何地圖上的控制局總部「最古老之屋」，最後成為局長。她救出受嘶嘶聲（Hiss）控制的狄倫後，狄倫雖然脫離控制卻陷入昏迷，而潔西留在總部處理收容危機。

續作中，收容全面失效，異常物件逃逸，異次元空間彼此碰撞，整座曼哈頓陷入混亂。玩家改為操控狄倫，在開放世界中尋找失蹤的姐姐；相較前作以槍械為主的戰鬥，新作則將主要戰鬥方式轉向近身格鬥。

結構錯位的曼哈頓與重力探索

《Control: Resonance》的開放世界延續系列的類銀河戰士惡魔城設計：玩家能探索的區域相當廣闊，但曼哈頓受到結構扭曲影響，街道與不同維度的空間交錯，部分道路看似相連，實際上卻無法通行。隨著故事推進，狄倫會取得新的移動能力，探索也逐漸變得自由；到了中後期，穿梭於交疊的摩天大樓之間，宛如在城市中擺盪，而不同空間的重力差異更添科幻與奇幻感。

光線追蹤與硬體合作介紹

影片接著展示遊戲的路徑追蹤與光線追蹤效果。以銀行玻璃為例，開啟光線追蹤後，窗戶能呈現街道對面建築的細緻倒影，包括窗格、立面與明暗變化；玻璃、車輛、金屬及地面水窪等反光材質，也讓城市空間顯得更完整。作者並說明 DLSS 3.5 的光線重建如何利用 AI 重建光追畫面，改善細節不穩、閃爍與移動時的拖影，讓畫面在鏡頭轉動和戰鬥中仍保持清晰穩定。

影片也穿插介紹 ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070，以及 ASUS T1 聯名 RTX 5070 顯示卡。後者採銀黑配色與紅色點綴，背板印有隊員文字、簽名及 T1 標誌，並附有貼紙與收藏磁鐵；2.5 槽設計、散熱風扇、低負載停轉功能與強化背板，則兼顧機殼相容性、散熱與耐用度。作者表示，透過光線重建、DLSS 與影格生成，在 2K 解析度下可兼顧畫質與流暢度，並引導觀眾前往資訊欄了解產品。

即使戰鬥有缺憾，仍值得體驗

介紹完硬體後，作者表示將回到《Control: Ultimate Edition》與遊戲內容。整體而言，作者認為《Control: Resonance》並非靠戰鬥取勝，而是以超自然科幻敘事、獨特的空間設計、重力變化與出色視聽表現形成鮮明魅力，因此即使戰鬥未能完全滿足自己，仍想推薦給玩家。

The story of Control is a bit. difficult to explain and quite vast; it's a supernatural sci-fi tale with a. touch of New Weird aesthetics. After the. slide projector opened a portal, it. triggered a series of events that. caught the attention of the Federal. Bureau of Control (FBC). She later. discovers this place is home to. mysterious ancient artifacts, and the. Bureau was built here to study them. Because the previous director died. under mysterious circumstances, the. Bureau decided to make Jessie, who came. looking for her brother, the next. director. After going through a massive. number of events, she finally finds her. brother, Dylan, who is under the. control of the Hiss. Jessie goes to. great lengths to purge the Hiss from. Dylan's body; although Dylan is no. longer under control, he falls into a. coma. Jess remained in the Oldest House. to manage containment breaches and. prevent disasters from escalating. However, in the sequel, containment. fails completely, allowing the breach. to ravage Manhattan. Anomalous objects. previously contained by the FBC have. escaped, and the threat is not singular. ; with spatial collisions between. dimensions and structural shifts, all. of Manhattan has descended into chaos. In the first game, you solved problems. within the FBC to find your brother. inside the labyrinthine Oldest House. and ended the containment breach. In. the sequel, you control your brother,. Dylan, searching for your missing. sister in an open-world Manhattan, with. the primary combat shifting from ranged. firearms to melee fighting. The. open-world level design in Control:. Resonance is quite different from every. other open-world game out there. The. map design in the Control series has. always had a strong Metroidvania vibe. House, but Control: Resonance expands. this concept to Manhattan, creating a. much more open world. After the. prologue ends, the range of movement we. have across the map is actually quite. vast. However, because Manhattan has. been affected by structural shifts,. causing entities from different. dimensions to merge, the city becomes. quite surreal. You will often see. another road at the end of a street. that is perpendicular to yours, so the. areas we can reach and explore are. limited to a certain extent. As the. story progresses, we gradually acquire. new movement abilities, making. exploration on the map become much. freer. Running from point A to point B. feels restrictive at first, but by the. mid-to-late game, thanks to the. interweaving skyscrapers from different. dimensions, moving through the city. feels a bit like Spider-Man swinging. through the urban landscape. With the ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070. co-branded graphics card, you can be. even more immersed in the ultimate. thrill of soaring through the city. This time, NVIDIA has added Path. Tracing support in Control: Resonance,. allowing both direct and indirect. lighting to be rendered in a more. consistent way. Notice this entire. row of windows on the bank; without ray. tracing enabled, the glass still has. its material properties and you can see. some basic light and dark variations,. but the amount of detail within the. glass is much lower, and the. reflections of the opposite buildings. are almost invisible. The game is set. in a densely built-up Manhattan, and as. we walk through the city, everything. around us—glass, cars, windows, metal. , and even puddles on the ground—is. made of materials that create. reflections. Sometimes, things not. directly in the camera's view can be. seen through reflections in nearby. glass, making the spatial sense of the. entire city feel much more complete. customer reservations, a coffee menu. listing various drink prices, some. weathered posters on the walls, and. limited-edition coffee promotions on. each table. Overall, you might. feel some frustration when you can't. solve a puzzle. I was playing the media. preview version, so there were no. guides to check, and with the added. time pressure, it was even more.

frustrating. But as for feeling. repetitive, even the puzzles that share. the same theme are newly designed, so. it doesn't really feel like a chore. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 快速了解《Control: Resonance》的故事背景，以及它如何延續前作的兄妹故事。
  • 解析遊戲獨特的曼哈頓開放世界、重力變化與逐步解鎖的探索方式。
  • 呈現作者對遊戲優缺點的平衡評價，說明即使戰鬥不夠有趣，作品仍值得推薦的原因。
  • 介紹光線追蹤、DLSS 與合作顯示卡等畫面技術及硬體資訊。

摘要

作者為何喜愛《Control: Resonance》

作者 Rice 分享自己遊玩《Control: Resonance》後的感受：雖然作為動作冒險遊戲，戰鬥並不特別有趣，甚至可能是作品的弱點，但故事呈現、控制主題、視覺風格、世界結構與重力變化都十分出色，配樂也令人印象深刻。作者認為作品有望在 2026 年遊戲大獎獲得美術指導與音樂相關提名，並將在影片中探討劇情、戰鬥、角色成長、開放世界與推薦理由。

從兄妹故事延伸的超自然科幻世界

系列故事起源於一對兄妹童年時發現的幻燈機，投射出的影像成了通往異次元的入口，並引來聯邦控制局（FBC）介入。弟弟狄倫被帶去接受實驗與訓練，姐姐潔西則在前作中為了尋找失蹤的弟弟，進入不在任何地圖上的控制局總部「最古老之屋」，最後成為局長。她救出受嘶嘶聲（Hiss）控制的狄倫後，狄倫雖然脫離控制卻陷入昏迷，而潔西留在總部處理收容危機。

續作中，收容全面失效，異常物件逃逸，異次元空間彼此碰撞，整座曼哈頓陷入混亂。玩家改為操控狄倫，在開放世界中尋找失蹤的姐姐；相較前作以槍械為主的戰鬥，新作則將主要戰鬥方式轉向近身格鬥。

結構錯位的曼哈頓與重力探索

《Control: Resonance》的開放世界延續系列的類銀河戰士惡魔城設計：玩家能探索的區域相當廣闊，但曼哈頓受到結構扭曲影響，街道與不同維度的空間交錯，部分道路看似相連，實際上卻無法通行。隨著故事推進，狄倫會取得新的移動能力，探索也逐漸變得自由；到了中後期，穿梭於交疊的摩天大樓之間，宛如在城市中擺盪，而不同空間的重力差異更添科幻與奇幻感。

光線追蹤與硬體合作介紹

影片接著展示遊戲的路徑追蹤與光線追蹤效果。以銀行玻璃為例，開啟光線追蹤後，窗戶能呈現街道對面建築的細緻倒影，包括窗格、立面與明暗變化；玻璃、車輛、金屬及地面水窪等反光材質，也讓城市空間顯得更完整。作者並說明 DLSS 3.5 的光線重建如何利用 AI 重建光追畫面，改善細節不穩、閃爍與移動時的拖影，讓畫面在鏡頭轉動和戰鬥中仍保持清晰穩定。

影片也穿插介紹 ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070，以及 ASUS T1 聯名 RTX 5070 顯示卡。後者採銀黑配色與紅色點綴，背板印有隊員文字、簽名及 T1 標誌，並附有貼紙與收藏磁鐵；2.5 槽設計、散熱風扇、低負載停轉功能與強化背板，則兼顧機殼相容性、散熱與耐用度。作者表示，透過光線重建、DLSS 與影格生成，在 2K 解析度下可兼顧畫質與流暢度，並引導觀眾前往資訊欄了解產品。

即使戰鬥有缺憾，仍值得體驗

介紹完硬體後，作者表示將回到《Control: Ultimate Edition》與遊戲內容。整體而言，作者認為《Control: Resonance》並非靠戰鬥取勝，而是以超自然科幻敘事、獨特的空間設計、重力變化與出色視聽表現形成鮮明魅力，因此即使戰鬥未能完全滿足自己，仍想推薦給玩家。

Hi, I'm Rice, welcome to my channel. I've spent some time these past few. days playing Remedy's Control:. Resonance, and wow, I really love it! Whenever I encounter a game I love this. much, I always feel a bit apprehensive. Especially as an open-world. action-adventure game, the combat in. Control: Resonance isn't particularly. fun; it might even be the game's weak. point. However, various other aspects. —like the way the story is presented,. the concept of control, the visual. expression, the structured world, and. the gravity-shifting effects—are all. quite outstanding. The story of Control is a bit. difficult to explain and quite vast; it's a supernatural sci-fi tale with a. touch of New Weird aesthetics. The. story of Control originates from a. brother and sister who, as children,. found a slide projector. The images. projected by the slides turned into. portals to another dimension. After the. slide projector opened a portal, it. triggered a series of events that. caught the attention of the Federal. Bureau of Control (FBC). Subsequently,. the younger brother, Dylan, was taken. to the FBC for experimentation and. training, eventually becoming one of. the FBC's potential directors. The. protagonist of the first game is his. sister, Jessie. In order to find her. kidnapped brother, she tracks down the. Federal Bureau of Control, which. doesn't appear on any maps. She later. discovers this place is home to. mysterious ancient artifacts, and the. Bureau was built here to study them. Because the previous director died. under mysterious circumstances, the. Bureau decided to make Jessie, who came. looking for her brother, the next. director. After going through a massive. number of events, she finally finds her. brother, Dylan, who is under the. control of the Hiss. Jessie goes to. great lengths to purge the Hiss from. Dylan's body; although Dylan is no. longer under control, he falls into a. coma. Jess remained in the Oldest House. to manage containment breaches and. prevent disasters from escalating. However, in the sequel, containment. fails completely, allowing the breach. to ravage Manhattan. Anomalous objects. previously contained by the FBC have. escaped, and the threat is not singular. ; with spatial collisions between. dimensions and structural shifts, all. of Manhattan has descended into chaos. In the first game, you solved problems. within the FBC to find your brother. inside the labyrinthine Oldest House. and ended the containment breach. In. the sequel, you control your brother,. Dylan, searching for your missing. sister in an open-world Manhattan, with. the primary combat shifting from ranged. firearms to melee fighting. The. open-world level design in Control:. Resonance is quite different from every. other open-world game out there. The. map design in the Control series has. always had a strong Metroidvania vibe. The first game focused on exploration. within the massive, labyrinthine Oldest.

House, but Control: Resonance expands. this concept to Manhattan, creating a. much more open world. After the. prologue ends, the range of movement we. have across the map is actually quite. vast. However, because Manhattan has. been affected by structural shifts,. causing entities from different. dimensions to merge, the city becomes. quite surreal. You will often see. another road at the end of a street. that is perpendicular to yours, so the. areas we can reach and explore are. limited to a certain extent. As the. story progresses, we gradually acquire. new movement abilities, making. exploration on the map become much. freer. Running from point A to point B. feels restrictive at first, but by the. mid-to-late game, thanks to the. interweaving skyscrapers from different. dimensions, moving through the city. feels a bit like Spider-Man swinging. through the urban landscape. With the ASUS TUF GeForce RTX 5070. co-branded graphics card, you can be. even more immersed in the ultimate. thrill of soaring through the city. This time, NVIDIA has added Path. Tracing support in Control: Resonance,. allowing both direct and indirect. lighting to be rendered in a more. consistent way. Notice this entire. row of windows on the bank; without ray. tracing enabled, the glass still has. its material properties and you can see. some basic light and dark variations,. but the amount of detail within the. glass is much lower, and the. reflections of the opposite buildings. are almost invisible. designed to further improve these. issues. I. really enjoy the gameplay of almost all. the main and side missions in Control. customer reservations, a coffee menu. listing various drink prices, some. weathered posters on the walls, and. limited-edition coffee promotions on. each table. 劇情主軸聚焦於金鋼狼活了兩百年的孤獨感、失憶的過去以及對野性的掙扎，同時展現他與琴·葛雷、艾薩克斯等人的複雜關係。遊戲中亦有死侍、死亡女及紅色歐米茄等經典角色登場。
